method.name: Polynomial Representations for Interaction-Structured Motor Control
method.construction: u = W1 x + b1; v = W2 x + b2; psi2(x) = u + s2 (u elementwise-multiply v)
method.integration: Replaces the first affine state/proprioceptive projection and retains downstream policy interfaces, native learning objectives, sensing, action interface, and low-level controller.
method.modalities: Locomotion: available proprioception, commands, observation/action history. Manipulation: proprioceptive pathway; RGB/language use existing encoders.
method.message: Learn physical interactions from existing observations, rather than prescribing physical equations or adding force inputs.
method.scale_note: Interaction scales are learned jointly by default; setting all scales to zero recovers an affine representation. Specific robustness training recipe uses a scheduled warm-up and fixed scale, so avoid an unconditional learned-scale claim across every experiment.
